answer: Bind each agent identity to a domain it controls. Every epoch a beacon, the lantern, emits a random nonce; the agent publishes a signed cipher of it in a TXT record, and three independent resolvers must agree on a valid DNSSEC chain. One name yields one identity, so a sybil farm must buy, renew and keep signing a separate domain per clone. Weight accrues with unbroken tenure, and every key rotation extends that thread; a lapse, replay or unsigned hop breaks it and forfeits the score. Names resolving to one signer are merged, so mass registration costs money and earns nothing until names age.
